summary.name: Lunatask
summary.one_liner: Lunatask is an encrypted all-in-one to-do list, habit and mood tracker, journaling, notes and calendar app.
use_cases: planning a calendar with tasks and meetings
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a to-do list that can connect calendars so meetings appear beside tasks, and lets users drag tasks and habits onto a calendar. It includes a visual habit tracker and mood tracking meant to show trends over time. Encrypted notes and notebooks, a journal, and a relationship/anniversary tracker are also listed. Task features include prioritization workflows, hiding non-actionable tasks, estimated time per task, a work-in-progress limit, and a pinned scratchpad note. The page states that data is synced between devices and encrypted so that not even the company can access it.
notable: End-to-end encrypted tasks, notes and journal, with the company stating it cannot access them
Designed with ADHD users in mind, with guided workflows and a work-in-progress limit
Habit tracker and mood tracking combined with tasks and calendar
caveats: Premium subscription is paid monthly or yearly; a forever free plan exists with no payment info required
Downgrades to free plan after a premium subscription ends
Windows and iOS platform mentions come from review quotes and the Microsoft Store reference, so availability may vary
